title: filesystem transport: queue_unbind does not update the exchange file, so unbound queues keep receiving messages
author: moneebullah25
body_preview: On the `filesystem://` transport, `Channel.queue_unbind` does not persist the removal of a binding. The in-memory `state.binding_delete` does run, so only the exchange file on disk is stale. The binding stays in the exchange file, so later direct/fanout publishes (including from other processes) are still routed to the unbound queue.  Cause: virtual `Channel.queue_unbind` modifies the table return...

title: RQ cron scheduler does not respect Django TIME_ZONE
author: chromium7
body_preview: ## Summary  Cron expressions registered through `django_rq` are evaluated in UTC instead of the timezone configured in Django's `TIME_ZONE`.  For example, with `TIME_ZONE = "Asia/Jakarta"`, a cron expression intended to run at `08:25` is scheduled for `08:25 UTC` and therefore runs at `15:25` Jakarta time.  ## Environment  - django-rq: 4.2.0 - rq: 2.12.0 - Django `TIME_ZONE`: `Asia/Jakarta` - Djan...

title: Support `COMMIT_MODE` for RQ's scheduler APIs
author: RealOrangeOne
body_preview: When enqueueing jobs using RQ's scheduler APIs (`enqueue_at`, `enqueue_in`), the `COMMIT_MODE` setting isn't respected.  It looks like this is because it's implemented by directly wrapping `enqueue_call`, but none of the other enqueue APIs (eg the above and `enqueue_job`).
